parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search on company name or national ID.

parameters.name: employeeCountCategory
parameters.description: Return only companies whose employee-count bucket matches.

parameters.name: companyStatus
parameters.description: Return only companies whose report status is one of the provided values (same status shown on each company). Omit for no constraint.

parameters.name: expiresWithin
parameters.description: Return only companies that have an approved report expiring within the given window. Multiple values are OR-ed; the largest window wins.

parameters.name: finesStarted
parameters.description: When true, return only companies in the daily-fines process (finesStarted = true).

parameters.name: quarantined
parameters.description: When true, return only quarantined companies (quarantined = true).

parameters.name: overdue
parameters.description: When true, return only companies whose next equality or salary report due date has passed.

parameters.name: isatCategoryCode
parameters.description: Return only companies whose admin-owned ÍSAT2008 category is one of the given leaf codes (e.g. "01110").

parameters.name: isatSection
parameters.description: Return only companies whose ÍSAT2008 section (bálkur) is one of the given letters, e.g. "O" for public administration. Case-insensitive. The premade industry filter — resolved via the company ÍSAT category, so companies with no ÍSAT code are excluded.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Return only companies in one of the given ownership sectors — the premade "private vs government/state" filter. UNKNOWN is filterable on its own and is never included in PRIVATE.

parameters.name: regionCode
parameters.description: Return only companies located in one of the given regions (landshluti), by region code (e.g. "CAPITAL"). Resolved via the company postcode.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Return only companies with one of the given postcodes (póstnúmer, e.g. "101").

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search on ÍSAT code or description (Icelandic/English). Returns the top matches.

parameters.name: codes
parameters.description: Resolve these exact ÍSAT leaf codes — used to label an existing selection. Takes precedence over `q`.

parameters.name: showInactive
parameters.description: When true, includes inactive users. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: regionCode
parameters.description: Return only postcodes belonging to one of the given region codes (e.g. "CAPITAL"). Omit for all postcodes.

parameters.name: unassignedReviewer
parameters.description: When true, returns only reports with no reviewer assigned. Overrides `reviewerUserId` if both are set.

parameters.name: hasImprovementPlan
parameters.description: When true, returns only reports that have at least one employee outlier (i.e. an improvement plan applies). When false, returns only reports with no outliers. Omit for no constraint.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search across company name, kennitala, and report identifier. Case-insensitive partial match. Person fields (contacts and company admin/CEO) are not searched.

get.description: Reports that include the given company — whether it filed on its own behalf or was included as a subsidiary on a parent company's group submission. Powers the company-detail reports tab. Newest first.

Paginated list of a report's employee outliers — the rows behind the Úrbótaáætlun table. Split out from the report-detail payload because a single salary report can carry hundreds of rows. Defaults to role title ascending, then `employeeOrdinal` ascending — the same grouped-by-role order the draft employee lists serve; override with `sortBy` + `direction`.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Restrict the list to the outliers belonging to a single group.

get.description: A report's outlier groups (id, name, and the shared reason/action/signature explanation). A report with detected outliers always has at least one group; multiple groups drive the per-group Úrbótaáætlun tables.

Reglulegt tímakaup ((grunnlaun + viðbótarlaun + hlunnindi) / greiddar stundir) by gender and total score (all criteria). Returns scatter data points, a linear regression line, score-bucket averages with wage gap, and overall totals.

Reglulegt tímakaup ((grunnlaun + viðbótarlaun + hlunnindi) / greiddar stundir) by gender and work score (mandatory criteria only, excludes PERSONAL). Returns scatter data points, a linear regression line, score-bucket averages with wage gap, and overall totals.

Gender wage gap for reglulegt tímakaup ((grunnlaun + viðbótarlaun + hlunnindi) / greiddar stundir). Returns average and median hourly wages per gender with both average-based and median-based wage gap percentages.

Average bonus salary (aukagreiðslur) and additional salary (viðbótarlaun) by gender. Raw monthly component sums, NOT converted to an hourly rate — they do not sit on the same scale as the reglulegt tímakaup figures. Returns per-gender breakdown with wage gap for each component and total.

200.description: Generates and returns the report as a PDF. The layout ("Jafnlaunaúttekt" or "Jafnréttisáætlun") is chosen from the report type.

info.title: Directorate of Equality — Internal API
info.description: Internal API for direct communication between the DoE web application (doe-web) and the DoE API. Covers report management, workflow transitions (assign, deny, approve), company administration (status, ÍSAT, daily-fines flag), comments, statistics, and user administration. Not intended for external consumers.

translatedMessage.description: User-facing, localized message safe to display directly in the client. Absent when the error has no curated translation.

key.description: S3 object key returned by the presign endpoint.

paidHours.description: Greiddar stundir í mánuðinum, yfirvinnustundir meðtaldar. Nefnari reglulegs tímakaups.

parsed.description: Parsed workbook payload from an excel import endpoint.

expectedHourlyWage.description: Væntanlegt tímakaup at this score, from the pooled log fit — exp(fitted), so a curve in krónur space, not the chart line.

contributionShare.description: Share of óskýrt this employee carries, in percent. Null when óskýrt is 0.

slope.description: kr./klst. per stig. 3dp — the slope dropped from ~1.000 kr/month-per-stig to ~8 kr./klst.-per-stig with the hourly switch, so 2dp would leave only two significant figures.

intercept.description: kr./klst. at score 0 — predicted pay for a job no company has, so treat it as "where the line starts" rather than as a wage.

rSquared.description: How much of the pay variation the starfsmatsstig actually explain — i.e. how much the line deserves to be trusted. Null when there is no variation to explain.

excluded.description: Rows excluded for a non-positive hourly wage.

xSumSquares.description: Σ(score − mean)². Zero means no slope is identifiable — test THIS, not slope !== null, because a degenerate fit returns slope 0.

explained.description: skýrt — the part explained by starfsmatsstig, log points.

unexplained.description: óskýrt — the residual. Identical to oskyrtLog.

expectedHourlyWage.description: Væntanlegt tímakaup at this score, from the pooled fit.

contributionLog.description: This employee's contribution to óskýrt, in log points. Signed; sums exactly to oskyrtLog across all employees.

contributionShare.description: contributionLog / oskyrtLog × 100. Null when óskýrt is 0.

isCorrectable.description: Underpaid AND of the disadvantaged gender — i.e. liftable.

inMinimumSet.description: Member of the lágmarksmengi: the fewest corrections that bring óskýrt under the benchmark.

rawGapBlockers.description: Codes only — the web maps these to Icelandic copy. Empty when the raw gap is available.

oskyrtBlockers.description: Echoes the raw-tier blockers so consumers need not reason about tiers.

warnings.description: Soft: the figures ARE computed but must be shown caveated.

counts.description: Always real numbers, even when the figures are unavailable — this is the actionable part of the message.

oskyrtLog.description: óskýrt in log points. Signed. Source of truth for the benchmark test.

rawGapPercent.description: ÓLEIÐRÉTTUR as displayed: (higher − lower) / higher on arithmetic means. Magnitude.

rawGapPercentGeometric.description: Geometric equivalent of rawGapPercent. Stored for basis swaps.

oskyrtPercent.description: LEIÐRÉTTUR launamunur: 1 − exp(−|óskýrt|). Magnitude. THE figure tested against the benchmark.

oskyrtPercentLowerBase.description: exp(|óskýrt|) − 1 — the lower-paid-group basis. Stored, not displayed.

correctableCount.description: All underpaid employees of the disadvantaged gender.

minimumSetSize.description: Size of the lágmarksmengi. 0 when already compliant.

oskyrtLogAfterMinimumSet.description: óskýrt in log points after correcting the lágmarksmengi.

thresholdLog.description: The benchmark in log points: −log(1 − benchmark/100).

SalaryDataBasisEnum.description: Whether the salary data describes one specific payroll month (`MONTH`) or a twelve-month average (`AVERAGE`).

name.description: Applicant-supplied label for the group. Not required to be unique. When omitted (the implicit single-group case) the server assigns a default name.

employeeOrdinals.description: Ordinals of the employees in `parsed.employees[]` this group covers.

companyAdminTitle.description: Job title (starfsheiti) of the company executive.

salaryDataBasis.description: Whether the salary data describes one specific payroll month (`MONTH`) or a twelve-month average (`AVERAGE`).

salaryDataPeriod.description: The payroll month the data is based on, as an ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`; the day is normalised to the 1st). Required when `salaryDataBasis` is `MONTH`. Must name a month that has already happened, no earlier than 36 months ago.

parsed.description: Parsed workbook payload from the excel import endpoint. Contains the criteria tree, role list, and employee rows.

reportId.description: Identifier of the newly created report row.

companyAdminTitle.description: Job title (starfsheiti) of the company executive.

equalityReportContent.description: Narrative gender-equality plan as base64-encoded HTML. Decoded server-side and persisted as `report.equality_report_content`.

code.description: ÍSAT2008 section (bálkur) letter: "A"–"U", or "X" for unknown activity.

section.description: ÍSAT2008 section (bálkur) letter this leaf rolls up into: "A"–"U", or "X" for unknown activity.

division.description: ÍSAT2008 division — the 2-digit code prefix, e.g. "01".

isatSection.description: The resolved section, when it was joined in. Null when not loaded — read `section` for the letter itself.

email.description: Contact email for the company. Used by the deadline-reminder task.

finesStarted.description: Daily-fines flag. `true` means the company is in the daily-fines process, handled outside this system.

quarantined.description: Admin halt switch. `true` means all outbound activity (scheduled jobs, emails, notifications) for the company is suspended.

isatCategoryCode.description: Normalized ÍSAT2008 leaf code (admin-owned statistics field), e.g. "01110".

sector.description: Ownership sector (private vs government/state), derived from the RSK legal form. UNKNOWN means unclassified — it does NOT mean private.

sectorOverride.description: True when an admin set the sector by hand; a backfill must not overwrite it.

legalFormId.description: RSK's raw legal-form code (rekstrarform), as returned.

legalFormName.description: RSK's raw legal-form name. Useful for seeing the form behind an UNKNOWN sector.

equalityReportOverdue.description: Derived: the company's next equality-report due date has passed.

salaryReportOverdue.description: Derived: the company's next salary-report due date has passed.

statusReason.description: Reason the company is not active (null when active). Shown on the create screen.

isatCategory.description: Resolved ÍSAT2008 classification, e.g. "62.01.0 Computer programming".

sector.description: Ownership sector derived from the RSK legal form, exactly as `create` will store it. UNKNOWN here means the legal form is one we do not map yet — the create screen is the cheapest place for an admin to notice that, rather than after the row exists.

legalFormName.description: Raw RSK legal form name (rekstrarform) the sector was derived from, e.g. "Einkahlutafélag". Null when RSK carried no legal form.

reason.description: Optional reason for the change, e.g. bankruptcy or merger.

sector.description: The ownership sector to set. PRIVATE or PUBLIC marks the classification as admin-owned (`sectorOverride = true`), so a backfill will not overwrite it. UNKNOWN clears the override and hands the company back to automatic RSK classification.

isatCategoryCode.description: Normalized ÍSAT2008 leaf code, e.g. "01110". Null clears the classification.

finesStarted.description: Whether the company is in the daily-fines process (handled outside this system). `true` starts it, `false` stops it.

reason.description: Optional reason for starting/stopping the fines process, kept on the company timeline for later audit.

email.description: Contact email for the company. Null (or empty) clears it. Read by the report-deadline-reminder task.

quarantined.description: Whether the company is quarantined (all outbound activity halted). `true` quarantines it, `false` lifts it.

reason.description: Optional reason for quarantining/lifting, kept on the company timeline for later audit.

authorName.description: Full name of the admin who authored the comment.

note.description: Soft notice, e.g. an unresolved postcode that was left unset.

year.description: Reporting year (TEKJUAR) from the file, if consistent.

noticeCount.description: Notice from a soft issue, e.g. an unresolved postcode.

url.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL the client uploads the .xlsx to. Expires in 1h.

key.description: Object key the upload lands at. Pass this back to the import endpoint.

nationalId.description: National ID. Accepts XXXXXXXXXX, XXXXXX-XXXX, or XXXXXX XXXX — always normalised to XXXXXXXXXX.

code.description: Stable machine key for the region, e.g. CAPITAL

companyAdminTitle.description: Job title (starfsheiti) of the company executive.

companyFinesStarted.description: Daily-fines flag. `true` means the company is currently in the daily-fines process.

companyQuarantined.description: Quarantine flag. `true` means the company is currently quarantined.

includesImprovementPlan.description: True when the report has at least one employee outlier — outliers are the input that drives the company-side improvement plan.

authorName.description: Full name of the authoring reviewer. Null for company-authored comments (no individual person).

salary.description: Frosin samantekt á reglulegu tímakaupi við innsendingu (heildartölur + stigabil).

companyAdminTitle.description: Job title (starfsheiti) of the company executive.

salaryDataBasis.description: Salary-only. Whether the submitted salary data describes one specific payroll month (`MONTH`, with the month in `salaryDataPeriod`) or a twelve-month average (`AVERAGE`). Null on equality reports and on salary reports submitted before the field existed.

salaryDataPeriod.description: The payroll month the salary data is based on, as an ISO date normalised to the 1st of that month (`YYYY-MM-01`). Set when `salaryDataBasis` is `MONTH`, null for `AVERAGE`.

outliersPostponed.description: Salary-only. Null on equality reports. When true, the company has acknowledged every outlier on this salary report but deferred the explanations — all outlier rows are persisted with NULL explanation columns.

companyFinesStarted.description: Daily-fines flag. `true` means the company is currently in the daily-fines process.

companyQuarantined.description: Quarantine flag. `true` means the company is currently quarantined.

includesImprovementPlan.description: True when the report has at least one employee outlier. The full list is fetched separately via `GET /reports/:id/outliers`.

employeeOrdinal.description: 1-indexed ordinal of the outlier employee in the report's parsed employee list. Mirrors `report_employee.ordinal` — used to cross-reference the canonical detected set on `report_result.wage_gap_decomposition_snapshot.employees`.

groupId.description: Id of the outlier group this outlier belongs to. Every outlier always belongs to exactly one group.

groupName.description: Name of the outlier group this outlier belongs to. Denormalized from the group for convenient client-side grouping/labeling.

reason.description: Explanation shared by the group. Denormalized from the outlier group — every outlier in the same group carries the same value. Null only while the parent report has `status = POSTPONED`.

regularHourlyWage.description: Reglulegt tímakaup (kr./klst.) at submission, projected from the matching `wage_gap_decomposition_snapshot.employees` entry. Null if the snapshot has no matching ordinal.

expectedHourlyWage.description: Væntanlegt tímakaup at this employee's score, from the pooled log fit. Null when no matching snapshot entry exists.

deviationPercent.description: Signed percent deviation of the actual tímakaup from the expected one.

payStatus.description: 'UNDERPAID' | 'OVERPAID' | 'ON_LINE' relative to the pooled fit. Members of the lágmarksmengi are always UNDERPAID — the set is lift-only.

contributionShare.description: Share of the company-wide óskýrt figure this employee carries, in percent. This — not any individual tolerance — is why the row is on the list.

name.description: Applicant-supplied label for the group. Non-empty. The implicit single group created when no grouping is provided uses a default name.

reason.description: Null only while the parent report is postponed (explanation not yet filled). Otherwise non-empty.

userId.description: Target reviewer user id. Omit to assign to the caller, pass a UUID to assign to a specific active user, or pass null to unassign (returns the report to the SUBMITTED queue).
